findings.problem: "Ya vengo" means "I'll be right back" (going and returning), not "I'll be right there", which would be "ya voy".
findings.fix: example.en: Wait a moment, I'll be right back.

back.example: Wait a moment, I'll be right back.

note: "Instante" also means moment, but "el momento" is clearly the everyday answer, so no hint is needed.
